h2: NDT training in Texas: colleges, schools, on-the-job routes and online study compared
html:
NDT training in Texas: colleges, schools, on-the-job routes and online study compared

Texas is one of the few states where a candidate searching "NDT school near me" has real choices: community college programmes, a private technical school, contractor training and online study. That is good news, but it also makes the choice harder. The right route depends on whether you already have an NDT job, where you live, and whether you need a campus credential or a certification your employer will sign.

Who offers NDT training around Texas?

  • San Jacinto College (Houston area). Offers NDT certificate and associate degree pathways. A campus programme with lab time, close to the Ship Channel employers.
  • Lone Star College (north Houston). Lists inspection technology programmes and method certificates such as ultrasonic and visual examination at Level I.
  • Del Mar College (Corpus Christi). Runs a nondestructive testing technology programme serving the Coastal Bend refining and export economy.
  • Tarrant County College (Fort Worth). Offers a nondestructive inspection, testing and evaluation programme, with obvious relevance to the aerospace employers of the Metroplex.
  • Amarillo College. Runs an NDT programme in the Panhandle.
  • Universal Technical Institute (Houston). A private school with an NDT training programme at its Houston campus.
  • Contractor and operator training. Refiners, petrochemical plants, pipeline operators and the inspection companies serving them train trainees on the job, log their hours and certify them. Many Texas technicians never attend a school at all.
  • Self-paced online theory with an employer practical. Suits working technicians on turnaround schedules and employers who want training on their own equipment.

Programme names and details change from year to year, so check each college's current catalogue before you apply.

Which route fits you?

Your situationRoute that usually fitsWhat to watch
No NDT job, want a campus credentialA community college certificate or degree near youA diploma is not certification; an employer still certifies you after logged experience
No NDT job, want to start earning quicklyA trainee role with an inspection contractorAsk how the company documents training and experience hours
Working technician adding a method or levelSelf-paced theory, practical at your employerConfirm your written practice accepts the hours first
Employer qualifying a crew before a turnaroundOn-site training at your plant or yard with Level III oversightOwner and operator contractor rules may add requirements

Questions to ask any NDT training provider in Texas

  1. How many documented training hours does each method and level give, and do they match SNT-TC-1A?
  2. Who runs the practical, and on which specimens: pipe welds, plate, corroded samples, tubes?
  3. Who certifies me at the end? Under SNT-TC-1A it is the employer, never the school.
  4. Is a Level III reachable while I study?
  5. Can the course lead into ASNT central certification if I want a credential that moves between employers?
  6. For radiography: does the course explain that Texas radiation licensing is separate from RT training?

A word on radiography, because so many Texas programmes include it. Industrial radiography in Texas is licensed by the Texas Department of State Health Services, and the radiography company holds that licence. Completing an RT course, at a college or online, teaches interpretation and technique but does not entitle anyone to handle a source; the licensee trains and qualifies its own radiographers.

Where Atlantis fits for Texas candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has an office in Houston but no classroom anywhere in Texas. Theory is self-paced on the Atlantis portal with question-and-answer support from an ASNT NDT Level III, and access opens the moment you enrol. Practicals run in the Practical NDT simulator and then in person on real parts at the employer's own plant, shop or yard, under a written practice built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A. It fits the technician who cannot leave a rotation for a semester, and the contractor who wants a crew qualified on its own equipment before the next outage.

Start with NDT Level 1 training, UT training or ASNT Level III preparation, and check your hours with the SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker. City pages for Houston, Corpus Christi and Midland cover local employers, and welding inspectors can see CWI exam prep in Houston.
